summary: Implemented reply-threading propagation for approve/resume flows by plumbing replyToMessageId through startGoalResume, runGoalInBackground fallback paths, callback/command/reaction entrypoints, and early failure replies. Extracted and exported sendGoalBackgroundResult helper with replyTo support, updated callers to use it, and added deterministic tests for ga/gResume callbacks, /goal_approve, /goal_resume, plus direct sendGoalBackgroundResult behavior. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts (pass) and oxfmt/oxlint on touched files; full pnpm vitest run src/telegram/ was also executed but fails due many pre-existing unrelated telegram bot test failures and worker OOM.
